tier1.text: The femoral artery gives off branches that bring blood to the deep muscles of the thigh. The femoral artery begins where the external iliac artery, the leg's main blood supply, crosses the body wall. The femoral artery lies in the femoral triangle, the area where the hip meets the leg. Behind the knee, the femoral artery takes a new name: the popliteal artery.

quotes.quote: it is renamed the femoral artery. It gives off several smaller branches as well as the lateral deep femoral artery that in turn gives rise to a lateral circumflex artery. These arteries supply blood to the deep muscles of the thigh as well as ventral and lateral regions of the integument.

quotes.quote: The external iliac artery exits the body cavity and enters the femoral region of the lower leg (). As it passes through the body wall, it is renamed the femoral artery.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The external iliac artery becomes the femoral artery and is the main blood supply for the leg.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

sentences.text: The femoral artery lies in the femoral triangle, the area where the hip meets the leg.

quotes.quote: femoral triangle: region formed at the junction between the hip and the leg and includes the pectineus, femoral nerve, femoral artery, femoral vein, and deep inguinal lymph nodes
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Behind the knee, the femoral artery takes a new name: the popliteal artery.

quotes.quote: As the femoral artery passes posterior to the knee near the popliteal fossa, it is called the popliteal artery.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
